definitions.explanation: A box or container for storing and organizing tools. Can refer to a physical toolbox for carpentry or repairs, or a box for art supplies and other implements.

examples.japanese: {道具箱|どうぐばこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ハンマー→ハンマー：25887_hanmaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}した→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。
examples.english: I took a hammer out of the toolbox.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道具箱|どうぐばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name on the arts and crafts toolbox.

examples.japanese: {道具箱|どうぐばこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}らかっていて→散らかる：04357_chirakaru⟧、⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧なネジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The toolbox was such a mess that I couldn't find the screws I needed.

notes:
USAGE:
{道具箱|どうぐばこ} is a straightforward compound of ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (tools) and ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box). In Japanese elementary schools, students have a {道具箱|どうぐばこ} for art and craft supplies that they keep at their desks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧ (to take out from the toolbox)
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧ (to organize the toolbox)
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in the toolbox)
